body.title: Register the deploy-step MCP tool into src/mcp/server.ts
body.summary: Wire the deploy-step loop into src/mcp/server.ts so handleDeployStep is exposed as an MCP tool alongside the existing workflow-step/analyze-step/build-step servers, using the shared phase/state transport. This is the private s1-owned server transport that closes the end-to-end path from an MCP caller through the chain (t6) to the daemon deploy-rpc seam. The full start→done proof runs over t6's stubbed stage runners, since the real s2–s6 stage bodies land later.
acceptanceChecks: src/mcp/server.ts registers the deploy-step tool driving handleDeployStep, joining the workflow-step/analyze-step/build-step sibling servers over the shared phase/state transport.
The registration is additive — it introduces the new deploy-step tool without altering existing MCP tool registrations.

A full start → discover → reuse → topology → {security, scale} → done loop, sequenced by t6's chain.ts over stubbed stage runners (deterministic DeploymentContextBundles), is dispatchable through the server and returns populated markdown on the done terminal, echoing the opaque state token verbatim each call.
repo defaults to $INSRC_REPO when omitted, matching the analyze-step fallback, and an unregistered fallback surfaces UnregisteredRepoError.
